code: import axios from'axios';const API_KEY=process.env.REACT_APP_WEATHER_API_KEY;const BASE_URL='https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather';const fetchWeatherData=async(lat,lon)=>{try{const response=await axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"?lat=").concat(lat,"&lon=").concat(lon,"&exclude=minutely,hourly,daily,alerts&appid=").concat(API_KEY,"&units=metric"));return response.data;}catch(error){console.error("Error fetching weather data:",error);return null;}};export{fetchWeatherData};
